notes.title: Enter the world of the occult in an interactive thriller!
notes.content:
Enter the world of the occult in Night Book, an interactive thriller!

This update brings minor bug fixes and optimisations.

[b]Night Book is an interactive thriller about an online interpreter who is tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home.[/b]

Loralyn works the night shift remotely from her home, live interpreting video calls from English to French and back again. Currently pregnant, with a husband working far away and caring for her mentally ill father, she is desperately trying to keep her family together and safe – but who is she prepared to sacrifice to survive? The fiancé, the baby, her father, or herself?

[previewyoutube=Gi-XJkRbhjw;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES
[list]
[*] One story, several different paths and endings.
[*] From the producers of The Complex and Five dates.
[*] Co-developed by the studio behind Maid of Sker.
[*] Starring Julie Dray (Avenue 5) and Colin Salmon (Resident Evil, Mortal Engines).
[*] A completely live action, interactive movie, filmed remotely during lockdown.
[/list]

Find out more [url=https://www.walesinteractive.com/nightbook]here[/url]

The live-action FMV game will star Misha and Ryan, two millennial Londoners in search of their special someone at a speed dating event. 

Speed daters can witness how their choices can strengthen or weaken relationships with potential love matches. As Misha and Ryan attempt to charm five distinct personalities each, they’ll face daunting ice-breaker challenges, shocking revelations, and plenty of awkward moments. Long conversations and deep questions lead to a variety of different outcomes.

notes.title: Release date, trailer and pre-order reveal!
notes.content:
Today we can reveal that the interactive occult thriller Night Book will release on PC, mobile, and all major consoles on July 27! With this news comes a brand new trailer that shows Loralyn, an online interpreter who's tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home. 

[h3]Coming July 27[/h3]
Coming to PC, PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and iOS on July 27. 

[h3]Pre-order Discount[/h3]
You can pre-order the game now with 10% discount! Want to wait until launch? Wishlist the game on Steam to show your support and be alerted when the game is live. 

[h3]New trailer[/h3]
Check out the new trailer below...

[previewyoutube=Gi-XJkRbhjw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]More about the game[/h3]
Night Book is full of supernatural terror and suspense as Loralyn, a pregnant translator working from home, is fiendishly tricked into bringing an untold evil into her life. With Loralyn’s husband away and her unwell father in the house with her, players, as Loralyn, must make major decisions that keep the family safe or unwittingly place them in grave danger. Though Night Book features one story, there are multiple paths and endings to discover.

Filmed remotely during lockdown, this entirely live-action title is an acting masterclass, with the close-quarters filming style only ramping up the tension and underlining the occult terror that Loralyn and her family face. Night Book stars an exquisite cast, including Julie Dray (Cyberpunk 2077, Avenue 5) and Colin Salmon (Resident Evil, Arrow, and Die Another Day).

[h3]Features[/h3]
• One story, several different paths and endings.
• From the producers of The Complex and Five dates.
• Co-developed by the studio behind Maid of Sker.
• Starring Julie Dray (Avenue 5) and Colin Salmon (Resident Evil, Mortal Engines).
• A completely live action, interactive movie, filmed remotely during lockdown.
